title: MV Custom HP Bar Plugin Commission?

posts.author: Twig_the_Blue_Pikmin
posts.body:
I've tried looking everywhere but I sadly couldnt find an HP Bar plugin that suits my needs (and the only one that could've breaks my game when I try to use it now for some reason... which is SRD's BattleHud) so I was wondering if there was a way to commission someone to make a plugin that DOES suit the way I'd like my HP Bars to look? Basically I want an HP Bar plugin that aims to recreate the HP Wheel from the Pikmin games (pictured below for reference) I'd really like it if when an enemy gets damaged it'd lower the HP Wheel similar to the gif below. My current solution to this is using States and Common Events but it can get kinda messy due to the "HP Wheel" actually being a state itself so it tends to make visuals for an enemy with multiple states way more cluttered and hard to decipher than usual.
Btw I use RPG Maker MV for my project so I'd like the plugin to be for that if anyone can!
I'll make due no matter what but I thought I'd just post and see in the off chance if someone could help me in making my game look the way I'd like it to
HP Bar Reference Gif:
EDIT: My bad on the paying for commission, im dumb and didnt know I couldnt request that here. Sorry.
But if someone still wants to do the commission for free I think that's allowed?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
you can make that bar relative easy with SRD_HUDmaker.
even you can do it through eventing.
Edit:
while you cannot commission yet due lower post,  you can only try to request one.
but additional info if you DO NOT want to use SRD_HUDMaker which can be made
with sprite width/sections which in your gif is 8 or 9 (full/empty).
we also need to know what plugins you use for it to make it compatible with
the plugin you use.
but SRD_HUDMaker is mostly ideal for it.
not to mention, is it based on 9HP or 900 HP or more but only
tick off every 10-15%?
we miss some crucial info as well which is important.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
I shared how to do it on segments, but the circle is same princeple:
piece1:
max value:
$gameParty.leader().mhp/5
current value:
$gameParty.leader()._hp-($gameParty.leader().mhp*4/5)
all the way for each piece (this only show 5 pieces)
piece5:
max value:
$gameParty.leader().mhp/5
current value:
$gameParty.leader()._hp
but you can use 9 or 10 or whatever and use the corresponding image.
so you can figure it out fairly easy.
if this goes above each enemy, that a plugin might be easier as there
are some plugins creating a gauge, modifying that one to a sprite base
is also easier done, so you got a base code for a gauge, and credit the
main author and the one modifying the plugin.
you can place the hud elsewhere that check the troop ID 0 to x.
but it really depends on your battle system/layout and how you want to show it.
